import Base

# Each field is a bit-plane: thirty-two cells count without carrying into each other.
type Counts is Data:
  Counts{one: U32, two: U32, four: U32, eight: U32}

# Add one simultaneous vote to every set bit.
def Counts.vote(counts: Counts, +votes: U32) -> Counts:
  match counts:
    case Counts{+one, +two, +four, eight}:
      +into_two = U32.and(one, votes)
      +into_four = U32.and(two, into_two)
      into_eight = U32.and(four, into_four)
      Counts{
        U32.xor(one, votes),
        U32.xor(two, into_two),
        U32.xor(four, into_four),
        U32.xor(eight, into_eight)
      }

# A source row casts left, middle and right; middle=0 removes the focal cells.
def Counts.cast(counts: Counts, +row: U32, middle: U32) -> Counts:
  Counts.vote(
    Counts.vote(
      Counts.vote(counts, U32.shl(row)),
      middle),
    U32.shr(row))

# Binary 2-or-3 becomes: two, no four/eight, and either one or already alive.
def Life.rule(counts: Counts, alive: U32) -> U32:
  match counts:
    case Counts{one, two, four, eight}:
      U32.and(
        two,
        U32.and(
          U32.not(four),
          U32.and(U32.not(eight), U32.or(one, alive))))

# Three casts are the Moore stencil: 3 above, 2 here, 3 below.
def Life.row(+above: U32, +here: U32, +below: U32) -> U32:
  Life.rule(
    Counts.cast(
      Counts.cast(
        Counts.cast(Counts{0, 0, 0, 0}, above, above),
        here,
        0),
      below,
      below),
    here)

# Row-major cells enter a row least-significant bit first.
def Rows.pack.one(
  cells: List<&2, U32>, +shift: Nat, row: U32
) -> U32:
  match cells:
    case Nil{}:
      row
    case cell <> rest:
      Rows.pack.one(
        rest,
        1n+shift,
        U32.or(row, U32.shln(cell, shift)))

def Rows.pack(
  height: Nat, +width: Nat, +cells: List<&2, U32>
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match height:
    case 0n:
      Nil{}
    case 1n+rest:
      Rows.pack.one(List.take(&2, U32, cells, width), 0n, 0)
        <> Rows.pack(rest, width, List.drop(&2, U32, cells, width))

# The zero rows implicit at both ends are the vertical dead boundary.
def Life.sweep(rows: List<&2, U32>, above: U32) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match rows:
    case Nil{}:
      Nil{}
    case +here <> +below:
      match below:
        case Nil{}:
          Life.row(above, here, 0) <> Nil{}
        case next <> _:
          Life.row(above, here, next)
            <> Life.sweep(below, here)

# Packing and unpacking use the same least-significant-bit-first basis.
def Rows.unpack.one(width: Nat, +row: U32) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match width:
    case 0n:
      Nil{}
    case 1n+rest:
      U32.and(row, 1) <> Rows.unpack.one(rest, U32.shr(row))

def Rows.unpack(
  rows: List<&2, U32>, +width: Nat
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match rows:
    case Nil{}:
      Nil{}
    case row <> rest:
      List.append(
        &2,
        U32,
        Rows.unpack.one(width, row),
        Rows.unpack(rest, width))

def step(
  width: U32, height: U32, cells: List<&2, U32>
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  +columns = U32.to_nat(width)
  Rows.unpack(
    Life.sweep(
      Rows.pack(U32.to_nat(height), columns, cells),
      0),
    columns)

def evolve(
  turns: Nat, +width: U32, +height: U32, cells: List<&2, U32>
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match turns:
    case 0n:
      cells
    case 1n+rest:
      evolve(rest, width, height, step(width, height, cells))
hypothesis: Concrete improvement hypothesis: express the implementation as one repeated operation—rows cast votes into bit-sliced Counts. The upper and lower rows cast three votes, while the focal row casts zero through its middle, making self-exclusion a parameter rather than a separate flank case. This fuses the former Tally.row and Tally.flank declarations, reduces the datatype to four direct consumers to avoid the reported truncated datatype context, corrects the misleading cell name to Life.row, and presents packing/unpacking as an explicitly symmetric basis change.
findings: Runtime feedback is confirmed: all Node, Bun, native and composition observations passed, and the semantic review found no issue. The prior compiler finding remains confirmed and the parameter-scrutinee repair is preserved in Life.rule. Style attention is confirmed as an actionable presentation and review-context issue, not a semantic defect: the revision removes the low-value row/flank split, establishes the cast/vote vocabulary, pairs Rows.pack with Rows.unpack, and reduces Counts context fan-out. No semantic finding required correction.
